scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @opsgit/flags-sdk && npm run build:cli && npm run build:flags
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w worker
